summary: Diff implements browser Notifications API support with Settings UI (toggle, permission prompt, test notification), adds local in-app notifications on class marking, and persists the new notification preference through IndexedDB and backup migration. Branding is refactored via a new BRANDING constant and used in InitialLoadSplash and Settings → About. However, the favicon update and required generated logo/favicon static assets are not evidenced in the provided diff summary, and it’s not verifiable that the uploaded logo is the only logo used everywhere in the UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace the app’s branding assets so the uploaded file (image.png) is the only logo used, shown exactly as provided, in all existing logo placements (Initial loading splash, Settings → About, and any other in-app logo usage).
missing_requirements.reason: Splash and About were updated to use BRANDING.logoPath, but the diff does not show the required static image asset being added, nor does it provide evidence that all other logo placements (beyond these two files) were updated to prevent any other logo from appearing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the browser tab icon/favicon to match the uploaded logo (image.png) exactly as provided, served from frontend static assets and referenced by frontend/index.html.
missing_requirements.reason: No changes to frontend/index.html are shown, and no favicon static asset addition is evidenced in the diff summary.
evidence: File diff summary has no entry for frontend/index.html
ADDED FILES list does not include a favicon asset path

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a new branding constants module with appName/tagline and centralized logo path usage.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to replace logo assets everywhere and update favicon; adding a branding constants module and new tagline is an implementation choice not explicitly requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Added emoji in notification titles/messages (e.g., 🎉 Test Notification, ✅/❌/🚫, 📚).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; while still English, these are additional UX embellishments beyond the stated requirements.
